name: ps1-lowpoly-night-render
keep: KEEP — the making of the image, copy exactly:
· MEDIUM: late-90s PS1/PS2-era real-time 3D render — visibly low polygon count, faceted angular geometry, blurry low-resolution textures stretched over the mesh.
· GROUND: a moody night-time city street receding behind, blurred buildings with lit windows, glowing streetlamps and a parked car, heavy atmospheric haze.
· LIGHT: dim greenish ambient glow, soft baked-in shadows, no crisp highlights; everything sits in murky low contrast.
· SIGNATURE TREATMENT: nostalgic game-engine artifacts — jagged aliased edges, texture warping, spiky card-based hair, hard triangular shadow shapes on the face.
· PALETTE: sickly emerald and jade greens dominating, cool slate-grey shadows, small amber window and taillight glows.
· TEXTURE: coarse dithered digital noise and CRT-like grain across the whole frame.
· MOOD: cyber-noir, lonely, dreamlike retro-videogame melancholy.
· No readable text, no letters, no numerals, no logo, no watermark anywhere.
